profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
I have over a decade of experience as a professional C++ backend developer.
Since 2017, I have been working in Microsoft Azure Archive Storage. I'm happy at my current position and when that changes, I'm planning on my next career move to be a sabbatical.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Acquired under Eden Rock Communications.
Implemented a simulator of uplink LTE traffic for research into new technologies in collaboration with small team of PhDs. Calculated transmission success rate from SINR values in different environments, including different mobile, base station, and signal interferer distribution schemes, transmission scheduler methods, antenna models, and interference avoidance strategies.
Worked in Python on Eden-NET, self organizing network solution, doing system interfacing, improving health monitoring module, implementing component mapping algorithms, miscellaneous debugging, and enhancing data parsers.
Led implementation effort of configuration management integration for Eden-NET, self organizing network solution, with new external Ericsson product.
Directed and worked with onboarding team to enable functionality across multiple and heterogeneous networks on key SON module
Created Python program for translating binary event and network data into CSV files with complexity around data version management and file ordering for use by system engineers.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Worked in C++ on a flight test platform for system support testing
Work was on networking, GUI design, flight data simulation, RF electronic warfare, and radar warning receivers
Awarded “Team Achievement Award” for contributions to a major software release

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Awarded “Team Achievement Award” for contributions to project building an integrated flight test platform for use as system test environment
Developed and conducted system and regression tests for three software releases
Worked in C++ on a flight test platform for system support testing
Used MFC GUI framework extensively on flight test platform
Worked in Ada and C++ on system messaging instrumentation framework
Worked on software maintenance of system adding new features and addressing bugs
Used Scrum as agile software development framework
